item.title: 【Requests】[REQ AUD] - Nickelodeon 500 GB Leak (2023)
item.description:
Hi i wonder if someone has these 500GB file from the Nickelodeon channel, which leaked in 2023, containing a lot of released and unreleased songs in lossless from many TV shows and movies

i've been searching for it since then, i only found two files, one with 7 GB and another with 4 GB but now i lost them too, the site where they were uploaded no longer works, i also need a Nickelodeon animated logo template which was on them (as a MP4/MOV/MKV video on a black background)

wish somebody has them and can share them with me, thanks, i heard that in these files there was the Every Witch Way full theme song, and the CatDog full theme song (2 minutes long, instead of the one Nickelodeon uploaded on Apple Music which is 46 secs long)
